scope: Zero-update controlled cross-corpus transfer to HoVer development claims with three distinct supporting documents; verification labels and supporting sentence IDs are never inputs.
dev_sha_source: Pinned official GitHub release linked by https://hover-nlp.github.io/
document_pool: All candidate title and context sentences in the complete official HotpotQA dev distractor v1 JSON. Same fixed text per title for every candidate, ignoring every source support flag. Join stripped sentences with one space; multiple texts: longest, with lexicographic tie break.
selection: Require exactly three distinct annotated support titles, annotated num_hops=3, all three case-sensitive title strings in the local source, nonempty texts. Sort claims by sha256('hover-transfer-v1-select|'+uid) and take first 256 unique normalized claim strings. Retain repeated Hotpot antecedents and cluster uncertainty by hpqa_id.
candidate_rule: Gold three titles plus top 17 nongold BM25 rank over every unique pool title. Candidate text is title plus body, ASCII lower terms excluding the prior bridge stoplist; standard BM25 k1=1.2,b=0.75,IDF ln[1+(N-df+.5)/(df+.5)], unique query terms. With equal scores sort by title lexicographically. Order the 20 candidates by sha256('hover-transfer-v1-order|'+uid+'|'+title).
features: Reproduce MuSiQue three-hop four unary and seven transition features from the same E5/BGE revisions and tokenization; input only claim and candidate title/body, with private gold sets carried only to independent evaluation. Predicted path excludes every previously selected candidate.
fixed_models: Existing MuSiQue Majority validation-selected frozen and fitted final, first_value, first_index and all_indices models for both eight and one training sign draws. Five original paired training seeds, no tuning or training on HoVer. Include lexical-only BM25 top three, direct E5 top three, direct BGE top three, and uniform random public reference.
metrics: Unordered document F1=r/3, complete set=(r==3), independent Rademacher majority disagreement=(1-r/4-I[r==3]/4)/2 where r is support overlap. Enumerate all possible shared sign assignments to verify this formula. No path order metric and no HoVer leaderboard score.
primary: On eight-draw selected models, first_index minus first_value difference in unordered document F1. Average the five training seeds within claim, then compute claim-mean contrast. Report paired percentile 95% confidence interval from 5000 same-cluster bootstrap resamples of Hotpot antecedent IDs with replacement (seed 861977), resampled clusters retaining every selected claim; denominator follows sampled claim count. Other arms and one-draw replication descriptive.
